title: Surreal Oracle Vision
description: A surreal symbolic artwork on black features concentric teal and orange circles containing multiple stylized faces, three eyes, and geometric patterns. White outlined hands reach inward from the sides while purple dripping forms and a hanging upside-down figure appear at the bottom, surrounded by abstract painted textures and celestial motifs.
prompt: Surreal symbolic painting with concentric teal and orange circles at center containing multiple stylized human faces, three watchful eyes, and triangular patterns on black background. White line art hands reach inward from the sides, purple dripping forms descend from below, with an upside-down hanging figure at the bottom. Includes geometric diamond shapes, celestial bodies, and expressive paint splatters in orange, teal, and purple.
